verdict.rationale: Sentry publishes a documented web API for programmatic access to organizations, teams, and data (sentry-docs-14/20), plus a CLI and MCP server enabling AI-native/agent-driven interaction (sentry-docs-19, sentry-probe-3). missing for 10: no public OpenAPI/swagger spec found (sentry-probe-2 shows 404s) and no independent hands-on confirmation of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
